notes.title: Patch Notes for ver. 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes for Update 3 (version 1.0.4)[/h1]

[b]Resolution Persistence:[/b]

The game now correctly remembers and applies the resolution between games.

[b]Sliding Bombs Check:[/b]

The Sliding Bombs setting is now properly saved and remembered between sessions.

[b]Invisible Aliens Fix:[/b]

Invisible Aliens now spawn and function correctly at the start of a game, without requiring a new game restart.

[b]Alien Firing Bug Resolved:[/b]

Fixed a bug where aliens would stop firing during gameplay, ensuring consistent enemy behavior.

[b]Other Fixes and Improvements:[/b]

Additional stability and performance improvements to enhance gameplay experience.

tags.bug: Invisible Aliens now spawn and function correctly at the start of a game, without requiring a new game restart.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.02
notes.content:
[b]New Features:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a debug window displaying alien speed and fire rate. Toggle it on or off by pressing ~.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where returning to the main menu in certain circumstances could cause the game to crash.
[*] Corrected a glitch where changing the player starting lives could display an incorrect number of lives at the top of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: First Patch available
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - Update 1.01[/h1]
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a "Wave Counter" to the lower left of the screen to track progression.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhanced tooltips for better clarity and usability.
[*] Updated Game Over menu navigation to support arrow keys and controller input.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where waves would not reset after starting a new game.
[*] Resolved a bug where certain settings changes were not applied on initial game startup.
[/list]

[*] Updated Game Over menu navigation to support arrow keys and controller input.
